note.en: Her signature and an excellent choice for any Ice Attack agent. It gives 24% CRIT Rate and 25% Ice DMG unconditionally, plus extra CRIT Rate after Basic Attack hits.
About 99%. An incredibly competitive option that often matches her signature. Its DEF shred is strong and lasts 3 seconds.
About 93%. Seed's signature has a ridiculous amount of CRIT Rate, only about 5% behind her signature's. DMG% bonuses saturate on her, so the stats matter most.
About 92%. The best general CRIT stat stick for Attack agents. CRIT DMG can saturate on her, but the sheer amount of stats still gives value.
About 84%. It does fine, with a decent CRIT Rate main stat and up to 25% DMG from behind, although the back-attack buff depends on positioning.
About 77%. A solid free-to-play option for Attack agents that gives 25% unconditional Basic ATK and a further 19.2% Combat ATK at S5 after a Dodge Counter or Quick Assist.
